summary: Build practical environmental project management skills with ISO-based planning, risk, monitoring, and reporting exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Environmental project management provides a structured way to plan and control projects pursuing environmental outcomes. For environmental project managers, sustainability leads, consultants, and engineering coordinators, it supports delivery from impact assessment and mitigation planning through monitoring and reporting. You’ll practise defining project scope, assessing and treating risks, controlling schedules and changes, coordinating stakeholders, and tracking environmental performance with evidence-based reports.
audienceIntro: Environmental project management is designed for professionals who coordinate environmental outcomes, technical workstreams, compliance evidence, and delivery decisions across multidisciplinary projects.
prerequisites: No formal project management certification is required. You should have basic familiarity with environmental activities, sustainability objectives, compliance records, or operational projects. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the templates during exercises.
